doc: Twelve points whose raw total closed + open + street lies within a hair of the normalization threshold 1 (Hadley 30, 5 deg of poleward back-trace, latitudes found by bisection): raw totals 0.995, 0.9999, 1 - 1e-6, 1 + 1e-6, 1 + 1e-4, 1.0006, 1.002, 1.006, 1.0099 (rising side, 32.6-32.9 deg), 1.0005 and 1.0085 (falling side, 36.6-36.9 deg) and the 1.002 point mirrored to the south (see total_raw in the outputs). Above 1 the weights are divided by the total (so they shrink by the excess, from 1e-6 up to 1 percent), at or below 1 they are untouched: the case pins the threshold to 1 itself (a threshold of 1.0001, 1.001, 1.01 or 0.99 changes the weights by far more than the tolerance). Float64 closed form: 1e-9 (as the sweeps). Outputs closed/open/street are the function result; convective (climate.convective_tendency of the latitude in degrees), cold (the cold-air ramp smoothstep(0, 8, |back lat| - |lat|) in degrees) and total_raw (closed + open + street before the normalization, which divides by it where it exceeds 1) are intermediates, there to localize a mismatch; they share the tolerance. params.constants holds the knees and weights written in the code.
